department: Department of Chemistry, College of Sciences

deadline.value: Chemistry's Ph.D. program deadline is July 1 (Spring: November 15), so international applicants must meet the earlier Graduate School international Fall deadline of May 19, 2027; apply by March 1, 2027 for Graduate School Awards consideration.

also.quote: Application student submission deadline (If program deadlines earlier, earliest deadline applies.) | Fall 2026 | May 19, 2026
Application Deadline for Ph.D | Spring Admission: November 15 | Fall Admission: July 1
Apply by March 1st to be considered

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required by the Department of Chemistry.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Exam (GRE) scores are not required by LSU New Orleans Department of Chemistry.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for Chemistry: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: Students complete a flexible first-year program and select a faculty dissertation supervisor around the end of their first semester.
supervisor.quote: Dissertation research is undertaken under the supervision of a faculty member of the student's choosing. Students are encouraged to make their selection and begin research at the end of their first semester.

funding.value: The department typically offers financial support (teaching assistantships for most incoming Ph.D. students, research assistantships for continuing students, and fellowships) to all accepted Ph.D. students, contingent upon available funding.
funding.quote: The Department typically offers financial support to all students accepted into the Ph.D. program. Teaching assistantships and research assistantships are available, and most new doctoral students begin as teaching assistants. ... All financial support of graduate students is contingent upon available funding.

entry_route.value: Applicants may enter directly with a bachelor's degree (students entering with a baccalaureate in chemistry typically take 5 years to complete the 60-credit-hour Ph.D.).
entry_route.quote: Students entering the Ph.D. program with a baccalaureate degree in chemistry typically take 5 years to complete the program.

notes: Requires 3 letters of recommendation, statement of purpose, and CV/resume. Research divisions include Analytical, Biochemistry, Inorganic, Medicinal, Materials, and Organic/Physical Chemistry.
